mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a kitchen addition in cities like Pacifica or Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen additions in Pacifica or Daly City typically require several permits, including building permits, electrical permits, plumbing permits, and potentially mechanical permits if new HVAC systems are installed. Structural alterations, changes to the building footprint, or significant utility modifications will always necessitate permits. Our team assists clients in identifying and securing all necessary local permits to ensure compliance with city regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen additions in Pacifica or Daly City typically require building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits, depending on the scope of work.
